name: clinmatch
description: Read-only ChatGPT plugin to search ClinMatch for public supervised dental and dental hygiene cleaning listings from training clinics by city, region, or country — showing what each listing offers, its city, and Free or price, with a link to the public listing on clinmatch.io for more information.

interface.longDescription:
ClinMatch helps people browse read-only public listings for supervised dental and dental hygiene cleaning at training clinics when they explicitly ask about supervised dental or dental hygiene cleaning in an area — not for symptoms, emergencies, or unrelated requests.

Use this plugin in ChatGPT to search listings by city, region, or country, review what each listing offers, its city, and Free or price, and open the public listing on clinmatch.io for more information.

The integration is read-only: it searches and shows listing details but does not create ClinMatch accounts or collect personal information inside ChatGPT.

Care shown on ClinMatch is provided in supervised clinical training settings. Listing details and supervision notes come from each program's published listing.
defaultPrompt: Find supervised dental cleaning listings near San Bernardino, CA
Find supervised dental cleaning listings in Garden Grove, CA
Find supervised dental hygiene cleaning listings in North York, ON
